selection_reason: APW-06 completed_verified in PR #445. APM-02 and APW-06 satisfy APM-05 dependencies; the owner-approved interleave selects APM-05 before CSW-10.
objective: Define Connected Cozy and Shared Automated Play so a Solo Cozy activity can become an invited shared space with explicit participant authority, cooperative projects/resource contribution, social activity, asynchronous contribution, live co-op windows, notification, leave/rejoin and deterministic recovery without authority bleed, duplicate state, hidden-information leakage or public-stranger matchmaking.
completion_gate: Solo Cozy can become invited Connected Cozy and later return to Solo/ordinary context without authority bleed, duplicate authoritative state, protected-information leakage or ambiguous contribution/recovery behavior, while shared automation remains bounded and inspectable.
required_design_questions: What durable Connected Cozy space/participation model reuses Personal/Campaign context without creating a second state engine?
How are invitations, join, decline, leave, revoke and rejoin authorized and recorded?
Which activity/project types can be shared, and which remain Personal-only, Campaign-governed or human/GM-required?
How do cooperative resource contributions reserve/commit/refund owning-domain resources without double spend?
How are simultaneous/live and asynchronous contributions ordered, versioned and recovered?
What participant roles/capabilities are needed without creating a global Connected-Cozy role?
How do shared social/relationship activities preserve human consent and avoid AI speaking/consenting for participants?
How do APW-06 shell/attention/notification/deep-link/visibility rules present invitations, contributions, waiting and results without hidden-count leakage?
How does a Solo Cozy activity become shared, and how can a participant later fork/continue Personal work without copying protected shared truth?
What optional automation/controller operations are allowed under APM-01 and where must human choice/proposal/GM review stop automation?
How are optional AI narration/suggestions filtered per participant visibility while no-AI core operation remains complete?
What exact provenance identifies space, activity, participant contribution, controller operation and resulting authoritative event?
What future seam is preserved for multiplayer AutoGM without requiring it in APM-05?
What mobile/accessibility/offline/recovery acceptance proves shared Cozy remains understandable and deterministic?
next_action: Execute APM-05 as a bounded design/governance tranche defining invited shared Cozy spaces, participant authority, cooperative activity/resource contribution, async/live coordination, notifications/visibility, leave/rejoin, automation/AI boundaries and deterministic recovery/accessibility acceptance.
